description: Change of use from a dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to a children's home (Use class C2) accommodating up to 2 Young people (aged under 18) with 24 hour care
decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate an identified local need for the proposed childcare facility or that it would serve the local community. In addition, no legal agreement has been secured to guarantee priority placements for children within the London Borough of Harrow, meaning the development would not ensure that local childcare needs are met. The proposal therefore represents an inappropriate change of use, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy H12 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies GR1 and HO7 of Harrow Local Plan (2021 - 2041).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposal would result in the loss of existing residential floorspace and no justification or reprovision has been made to demonstrate that this loss is acceptable. The development would therefore result in an unwarranted reduction in the Borough’s family housing stock, contrary to the relevant provisions in the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies H8A of the London Plan (2021), and HO1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
